anchor.heading: Overview
anchor.blockText: A focused set of fixes and improvements to the canvas editor's visual design and core interaction model. Several canvas toolbar controls are currently non-functional (row/column operations, wrap/unwrap), dragging elements does not work, layout guide lines do not appear, and panels (Preview, Source, Outline) are always visible regardless of whether the user needs them. The canvas also lacks the sketch-style aesthetic that signals to stakeholders that wireframes are intentionally rough. This spec covers restoring correct behaviour, hiding panels by default, and applying a unified sketch-style visual theme.

anchor.heading: User Story 2 - Drag elements to reorder them (Priority: P1)
anchor.blockText: A business analyst drags a button from one position in a row to another position in the same row, or drags a row to a different row in a column. The element moves to the new position, the canvas reflects the updated order, and the source is updated. The drag works with a standard pointer drag; no keyboard-only substitute is required here (keyboard move is handled by existing "Move to…").

reviewComments.comment: It should also be possible to drag items in and out of grid cells

decisions.decision: Store navigation links as steps in the existing activity flow block
decisions.why: Reuses setLink/createAndLink infrastructure with no new storage concept
decisions.rejected: New block type, Salt widget property, or localStorage

decisions.decision: New ScreenFlowCanvas.tsx for the screen node graph view
decisions.why: Existing FlowCanvas is a linear step editor, incompatible with a screen-map graph
decisions.rejected: Adapting FlowCanvas (would destroy step-editor) or a third-party graph library

decisions.decision: Move showGuides to SettingsStore instead of local useState
decisions.why: Local state resets on screen navigation; spec implies stable display preference

decisions.decision: Change isCollapsed() default for source/preview/outline to true
decisions.why: Satisfies FR-012 without touching DEFAULT_SETTINGS or stored preferences
decisions.rejected: Changing DEFAULT_SETTINGS (would affect shared constant and tests)

decisions.decision: Per-project panel state as projectPanels[projectId] in Settings
decisions.why: FR-013 requires per-project persistence; extends existing schema without migration
decisions.rejected: ProjectRecord schema change (large blast radius) or separate IDB store

decisions.decision: Palette drag via workspace-level DndContext with palette:: id prefix
decisions.why: EditorDnd contract unchanged; palette ids routed before canvas EditorDnd sees them
decisions.rejected: Extend EditorDnd type field (touches generic contract shared across surfaces)

decisions.decision: Sketch theme via CSS dashed borders and SVG filter for hand-drawn effect
decisions.why: Pure CSS, no new library, matches spec assumption
